narrative: About 1,570 employees across France, Germany, Benelux and Switzerland. Drivers and dock FTE are planned as volume ÷ productivity: groupage productivity is 7.8 shipments per FTE per day YTD against an 8.1 target. The November–December peak needs about 135 temporary FTE; German driver wages rose 5.2% in July.
